summary: Validated /api/admin/outbound-status: ran pytest (16/16 PASS incl. test_11a..e), curled all 5 live scenarios (happy, sentinel, no-sentinel, missing report, failing report), verified secret-leakage guarantee with a hand-crafted report containing 2 phone numbers + 4 secret-like keys + audio URLs + raw provider response + checks array — NONE leaked. Verified runtime-state consistency (admin endpoint and is_outbound_disabled() agree). Deploy preflight regression exits 0 and sentinel is auto-removed. Legacy /api/twilio/inbound* endpoints untouched. admin_router scoped strictly to /admin/*. Response has exactly the 7 required keys.
critical_code_review_comments: _read_selftest_report_safely correctly uses a whitelist (passed/finished_at/started_at/mode) rather than a blacklist — robust against future report-field additions.
Sentinel decision short-circuits before report inspection, preserving last_selftest_passed in response (useful for ops dashboards to see 'why was the sentinel raised').

admin_router is unauthenticated as intentionally documented (read-only, no secrets); ensure the reverse-proxy auth layer stays in place in production. Recommend adding a follow-up note in deploy docs.
Hand-crafted leak test confirmed zero leakage of phone numbers, API keys, BACKEND_URL, raw provider responses, audio URLs, or checks array.
seed_data_creation: None. Manipulated /tmp/outbound_selftest_report.json and /app/backend/OUTBOUND_DISABLED during scenario tests; all restored to clean state at end (real passing report present, no sentinel).
context_for_next_testing_agent: /api/admin/outbound-status is verified leak-free and behaviorally correct across all 5 scenarios. The endpoint is unauthenticated by design (admin reverse-proxy in production handles auth). If touching the safe-reader function, re-run tests/test_twilio_outbound_gate.py::test_11a..e and re-run the hand-crafted leak curl against a report containing phone numbers + audio URLs + 'checks' array.
rca of the issue: No issue — feature works as specified.
